measurement_notes: Native-only source inspection pilot, 15 sequential cases in one agent session; shared context and filesystem caches are not reset. elapsed_seconds is actual Date.now wall time from first case search to recorded answer, including reasoning and orchestration. Setup protocol reads were not timed and setup_seconds=0 means no indexing/setup was performed, not zero protocol overhead. Per-case token estimates are ceil((captured tool output characters + command characters)/4) input and ceil(answer characters/4) output; they are NOT total model/billed tokens and exclude inherited context, repeated context, reasoning and orchestration. No per-case model telemetry API was available. Tool calls count executed native inspection shell invocations including failed searches. files_opened counts unique existing source files whose content appeared in command output, including exact search excerpts; failed paths and protocol files excluded. native_fallback_calls=0 because native is the assigned baseline, not a fallback. Correctness is source-based self-assessment, not independent grading. See native-transcript.json for full command/output and timestamps.

runs.answer: brain_server imports the shared mcp singleton; _mcp loads environment, creates stateful FastMCP and calls register_all(mcp). The Starlette lifespan registers the job loop, best-effort opens the DB pool, loads watched projects and starts the watcher, then runs the MCP session manager; shutdown stops watcher and closes pool. Root and /health precede the root-mounted MCP app (/mcp) and return online status, protocol/tool count, boot/fingerprint, uptime and session diagnostics. /fingerprint exposes identity diagnostics. Direct execution starts Uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:8001.

runs.answer: After dotenv load, LM_PROXY_MEMORY_ENABLED is the master flag (default true). LM_PROXY_MEMORY_MODE defaults stateless, normalized to off; assist aliases are assistant/summary/local/small, full aliases stateful/enabled/hybrid, unknown values off. Persistence, Redis and injection require master enabled AND assist/full AND their respective LM_PROXY_MEMORY_ENABLE_PERSISTENCE, ENABLE_REDIS, ENABLE_INJECT flags (all default true). Embeddings require master enabled AND full AND ENABLE_EMBEDDINGS (default false). Thus default effective memory functions are off. Missing optional imports reset module references to None, and request paths must also check availability.

runs.answer: Each job persists serializable status, phase return codes/PIDs, log paths, timestamps and maintenance state to its runtime job directory/state.json using a unique temporary JSON file and atomic replace. load_job_record consults memory then disk; running/cancelling records are loaded into cache and reconciled. Reconciliation polls surviving Popen objects or tests saved PIDs with kill(pid,0); a dead PID gets a return code inferred from completion/error log text, otherwise failure. Once both phases finish it records cancelled/done/failed, removes the manifest, releases project/capacity locks, persists, and runs unfinished maintenance. This is bookkeeping recovery, not automatic re-execution of the indexing workload.

runs.answer: search_codebase_core resolves projects and intent/path/member hints, then queries each project's embeddings with vector rank plus full-text rank, weighted RRF 2/(60+semantic rank)+1/(60+keyword rank). Empty candidates may be rescued by runtime/path hints, otherwise return empty. Metadata/path/crate filters and metadata boosts apply; implementation policy uses scoring helpers for symbols, definitions, paths and entrypoints, while ordinary ranking penalizes docs/parser/binding surfaces. Definition/path and exact member usage grep can rescue indexed rows when leading results miss the intended target. Optional clone dedup and duplicate-aware postprocessing precede file/directory caps and top-k. The final grep supplement runs only when enabled and nonempty top results have low file diversity; broad mode enables it by default.

runs.answer: memory/retrieval_duplicates.py prepares candidate content/context and delegates group/pair analysis to ts_pack.analyze_duplicate_texts, with a configured runtime fallback; if unavailable it retains all candidates with empty groups. Its rerank contract combines diversity trace selection and duplicate analysis into keep/suppressed indices, representatives, group order and telemetry, mapping keep indices to returned rows. Code postprocessing invokes that contract when file dedup is enabled and debug/telemetry/experiments request it, then sorts implementation results and deduplicates files. Thus grouping metadata alone is not an unconditional suppression pass; selected representatives and keep indices affect candidates before final caps/top-k.

runs.answer: indexer.py is the CLI/export facade for index_docs. The pipeline bootstraps schema/pool and probes embeddings before crawling. Opt-in discovery expands seeds via llms.txt, sitemap and link discovery and deduplicates URLs; otherwise it uses filtered seeds. crawl_pages uses adaptive HTTP/Playwright crawling and extraction with trafilatura and host-specific fallbacks. chunk_content prefers ts_pack markdown/XML section-aware processing with source metadata; it falls back to line windows on failure. Chunks receive a deterministic SHA256 URL/index ID and are buffered at the embedding service batch size, embedded asynchronously and upserted into doc_embeddings with documentation ref_type, content/vector/context metadata. Conflict updates replace content/embedding/metadata/time; unavailable pool or write error returns zero.

runs.answer: get_symbol_context is the registered tool in code_intel/core.py. It resolves project/file/signature constraints and requires the graph driver, querying SYMBOL_CONTEXT_CYPHER for definition/call relationships, returning ambiguity guidance or selecting a candidate. No graph match returns not-found; graph failure returns an error rather than a source-only symbol search. Once a graph record exists, source preview first reads the local indexed file span with line/character caps; failing that, it retrieves a Postgres codebase_embeddings chunk for the same project/file, preferring declared-symbol match, definition role and nearest start line. Preview errors are swallowed, retaining graph context.

runs.answer: watch_project resolves an explicit workspace and checks it exists, or obtains valid local roots from the current MCP client when omitted, and adds a manual pinned watch through add_watch. add_watch persists the sorted pin set and synchronizes runtime roots; duplicate adds return false. unwatch_project resolves workspace and remove_watch removes/persists the pin and runtime entry. Startup restores only existing directories from persisted pins. The task polls manifest file mtimes/additions/deletions and calls index_fn on change, catching errors; stop cancels and awaits the task. maybe_auto_watch currently always returns false, so session activity does not automatically pin projects.

runs.answer: FastMCP is explicitly stateful (stateless_http=False), so old transport session IDs are handled by its session manager after restart. brain_server reads mcp-session-id and tests membership in session_manager._server_instances; boot identity is PID plus random suffix. Logging middleware does not reject itself: it observes a downstream 404 with incoming session header and logs stale-session rejection once per ID. Responses carry boot ID, fingerprint, known-session and active-session headers, and health/fingerprint endpoints expose matching diagnostics so clients can recognize restart and reinitialize.

runs.answer: Fingerprint hashes sorted registered tool names and sorted absolute source paths plus SHA256 content digests, returning 12 hex characters and tool count. Sources include inspect.getsourcefile(tool.fn), recursively collected Python under tools/graphrag_core/memory/local_embeddings and named helper/runtime Python files, plus explicit runtime entrypoint files supplied by the caller. Although requirements.txt and requirements-ci.txt appear in DEFAULT_IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE_ROOTS, _implementation_source_files only accepts .py files, so those dependency manifest changes do NOT actually contribute via defaults. Installed dependency versions are not separately hashed. Unreadable files contribute a sentinel; inability to list tools gives the hash of [].

runs.answer: trace_symbol_cross_project_core resolves explicit source/target workspace IDs. In the source graph it gathers exact named symbols plus export aliases, choosing the highest definition rank favoring implementation code over stubs, aliases, tests/support and init facades; a selected alias adds its underlying target name. Target-project callers are selected through CALLS/CALLS_INFERRED to matching names (the target symbol node is not constrained to the source project, an ambiguity limitation). Target Postgres chunks combine exact name/alias ILIKE matches with embedding/full-text RRF constrained to textual name matches, then deduplicate file/chunk. Role-aware ranking favors implementation/src/scripts/tools over tests/stubs, keeps at most five files, and separates implementation consumers from supporting references.

runs.answer: proxy/config.py leaves optional memory references None and catches ImportError; effective mode gates default off and availability checks guard use. App startup catches pool-opening failures, and request memory injection is guarded/caught. _persist_memory_best_effort returns immediately when disabled/off/missing store or summary, catches persistence failures, and gates Redis/Postgres/embedding work independently. Responses handler schedules persistence via asyncio.create_task. Injection returns original messages if disabled, dependencies absent or an exception occurs. These boundaries protect the proxy flow from optional integration failures; this is source inspection, not an outage test or a claim that every configuration/runtime error is caught.
